text_en: Hey, Gruper! Look at this soldier all on his lonesome.
Well, it's not like we all need to be holding each other's hands now, is it?
Soldier, if you're going it alone, you better take this. Makerel has a few spare potions.
Best thank Gruper, he seems to like you.
Go on then. If you're going off on your own, we'll bump into each other again.
